Always reads the brief first and audits against an anti-slop cheapness blacklist. Ships an anti-sameness layer (divergence) that composes a soul from five orthogonal axes instead of picking from a persona list, so repeat runs stop converging on one look. Routes single-element briefs to a component flow (8 mandatory states + a preview file) instead of the page apparatus. Carries a cross-run build log so rotation is enforced rather than narrated, and a mobile floor covering the six ways a crafted page breaks on a phone. Supports verb commands (audit · bolder · quieter · soul · diverge · animate · densify · redesign) for targeted iteration. Ships a motion layer that separates WHAT moves from HOW it is built: six routes (CSS · native scroll-driven · View Transitions/WAAPI · GSAP · Canvas/WebGL · zero-dependency CSS 3D space) against a ten-family effect catalogue of ~80 variants (spatial camera moves, particle fields, fluid & material, scroll narrative, typographic, image transform, geometric construction, physics & inertia, state transition, atmosphere), each family carrying its slop form; an effect→route lookup so a page stops shipping 60KB to do four lines of work; and a four-beat sheet that replaces "one spectacular hero over generic fade-ups" — because 「炫酷」 and 「好看」 select nothing, and every model answers them with the same particle hero. Separates 后台 (revolves around a batch of business objects) from 工作台 (revolves around one thing he does over and over) — one fork that decides density, soul and shell, resolved by what the thing revolves around rather than by head-count or screen; a workbench then picks a body, desktop or phone morph A.1. 输入一个行业名，输出一份投行/咨询级别的行业深度研究报告。覆盖八大维度：行业概览与定义边界、市场规模测算（TAM-SAM-SOM 双路径交叉验证）、产业链上下游、竞争格局与波特五力、PEST 宏观背景、价值链与 SCP、行业生命周期与趋势、关键成功要素 KSF 与机会威胁研判。
最大差异点是反幻觉：每个事实句强制标注【实证】/【估算】+ 可点击来源，关键数字必须两个独立信源交叉验证，查不到就明确写"缺失"并说明原因，绝不编造市场规模和市占率——这也是多数 AI 行研报告最容易翻车的地方。
当用户提到"行业研究""行研""行业分析""分析XX行业""XX行业怎么样""XX行业研究报告""行业深度研究""产业深度研究""市场研究""市场调研""市场规模""市场容量""TAM/SAM/SOM""竞争格局""竞争对手分析""竞品分析""产业链""上下游""波特五力""五力""SCP""产业分析""行业生命周期""关键成功要素""KSF""行业趋势""行业前景""行业机会和威胁""市场份额""市占率""政策梳理""价格带""价位分布""品牌竞争""品牌矩阵""产品结构""消费人群""评价关键词""评论分析""口碑分析""扫一下这个行业""做个行业概览""摸个底""桌面研究""desk research"时触发；用户只给出一个行业/赛道/消费品类名并要求摸底、对标、估算规模、写报告时也触发。
输入：行业名/赛道名/竞品清单；输出可喂 swot-analysis、biz-diagnosis、strategy-map。
不适用：访谈整理→interview-insight；企业内部诊断→biz-diagnosis；跨境电商税务合规→tax-compliance-research；纯 PPT 排版→moways-ppt。与 macro-pest 消歧：PEST 只是行研里一节宏观背景→留本 skill；PEST/PESTEL 本身就是交付物（战略规划"外部环境章节"、六维深扫、区域/企业外部环境、要拉 GDP/CPI/利率等宏观硬数据）→ 让位 macro-pest。
采集层说明：优先使用 WorkBuddy 内置 WebSearch + WebFetch 进行公开网页采集；如已配置 Scrapling 等 MCP 连接器，可升级为反爬/动态渲染采集并标注采集方式。
